items.source: Detect HTTP Service types in the given packages, looking for interfaces with type or method HttpExchange annotations.
items.translation: 在给定包中检测 HTTP 服务类型，查找带有 `HttpExchange` 注解的类型或方法接口。

items.source: Variant of detectInBasePackages(Class[]) with a String package name.
items.translation: 带有字符串包名称的 `detectInBasePackages(Class[])` 变体。

items.source: Register HTTP Service types associated with this group.
items.translation: 注册与此组关联的 HTTP 服务类型。

items.source: Register HTTP Service types using fully qualified type names.
items.translation: 使用完全限定的类型名称注册 HTTP 服务类型。

items.source: Rossen Stoyanchev, Phillip Webb, Olga Maciaszek-Sharma, Stephane Nicoll
items.translation: Rossen Stoyanchev, Phillip Webb, Olga Maciaszek-Sharma, Stephane Nicoll

items.source: Spec to list or scan for HTTP Service types.
items.translation: 用于列出或扫描 HTTP 服务类型的规范。
